nodes.description: totalSupply: total token supply of ITGToken, mutated by mint/burn and set in constructor
balances: mapping(address => uint) of token holder balances
allowed: nested mapping of ERC20 allowances
owner: privileged address in Authable, master of onlyOwner functions
executor: secondary privileged address accepted by onlyAuth
withdrawRestriction: per-address unlock timestamp enforced by beforeTransfer

games: Games contract instance trusted by ITGToken
voting: Voting contract instance trusted by ITGToken

participantsForPreSale: pre-sale contributions per address
participantsFor1stSale: first sale contributions per address
participantsFor3rdSale: third sale contributions per address
t: sale start/deadline timestamps used with block.timestamp
cs: custom sale attributes including price and supply
participantsForCustomSale: custom sale contributions keyed by start time and address

voteStart: voting window start per vote id
voteEnd: voting window end per vote id, also used as duplicate guard
maxCandidateId: upper bound of candidate ids for a vote
voted: double-vote guard per vote id and voter

f: per-period funded eth/token status counters

r: range game time tolerance attributes

winners: per-year eth prize balances per address
tokTakers: per-year token prize balances per address

tokPrizes: per-year aggregated token prize pool
